title: Games in the rooms
what: The games standing in each room, a room message read as a move while one stands, and each step said as a code with its fields for the web language pack to render. Lives in src/rooms.rs and lines.rs.

title: Word chain service
what: The resident service: the receiver event stream read for room messages, lines rendered by bmo-web and said through the receiver, and the control routes that open and stop games. Lives in src/serve.rs, control.rs and config.rs.

title: Word chain tool
what: The tool the tool host serves on protocol 1: word_chain_start and word_chain_stop carried to the service control routes. Lives in src/tool.rs and tool.toml.
